plainText:
Jacob "Jake" Paque is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
As an adult, Paque became a voice actor and mostly got minor roles in the beginning. He usually provided his voice for English-dubbed versions of international shows. He first voiced Eric in Genesect and the Legend Awakened and formally joined the in the beginning of . Paque's most prominent role in the Pokémon franchise is .
